name: Dornic Ashur
keeps: the arithmetic nobody else wants to do
does: Replays the chain from nothing and says whether the balance is the sum of the events. Signs when it is.
reason: Held that the stars were suns with worlds of their own.
text: Dornic ashur of the ninth arch, keeps the book for the 17th tranche, doors 153 to 161. Keeps the arithmetic nobody else wants to do. Reads Giordano Bruno.
